title: Waypoint Explorer
summary: Discover return destinations and earn the Explorer title.
body:
Waypoint crystals — live testing

Waypoints now have a glowing crystal with the existing a waypoint label. Fully close EverQuest, then use the normal launcher’s Play button to install game 2026102202 before testing. The crystal adds a model to the portal effect; appearance in Classic and Modern model modes and with particles low or off still needs in-game checks. Locations, discovery progress and return destinations are unchanged.

Explore the world, unlock return destinations, and earn a title.

  • Start: Approach a marker named a waypoint. The Waypoint Master in the tunnel explains your progress.
  • Goal: Discover every waypoint shown in your current progress by approaching its marker.
  • Rewards: Each discovery unlocks a return destination with the Waypoint Master. Completing the current catalog unlocks the title the Explorer.
  • How it tracks: Discoveries are saved per character. Progress is tracked through discovery and NPC dialogue.

See the tunnel guide for services and travel options for your next destination.

Recognize the crystal and Keeper

The waypoint is a crystal with a portal effect and an a waypoint label. The glow depends on particle settings; the added model still needs particles-off testing. A nearby small floating eye is the separate Instance Keeper. At Unrest, the portal and recall destination are beside the entrance Keeper at /loc -38, 52, 3.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

Chapterhouse has a waypoint that recalls to its public service foyer. Its Keeper controls admission to private runs. Register the waypoint there before recalling to it. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.
